== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Seishen Kingdom is a sovereign entity led by [[King Dakata]], a ruler noted for his integrity and the prosperity of his people. The kingdom's royal family includes the first prince, Prince Seishen Kiro{{!}}Seishen Kiro, and his younger brother, [[Seishen Daji]]. The monarchy has also included high-ranking figures such as [[Underlady]] [[Riyusai Meira]]. The kingdom maintains a presence in the [[Night Wheel Valley]], where [[King Dakata]] constructed a [[stone]] castle using [[Ruler techniques]]. While intended to project majesty, the [[fortress]] was small in comparison to the [[Akura clan]]'s structures. The kingdom possesses advanced armor and a military composed of [[Golds]], [[Lords]], [[Ladies]], and various Underlord{{!}}Underlords. The Seishen Kingdom has been involved in significant conflict, including an unexpected attack and efforts to push against The Empire{{!}}the Empire. These military actions resulted in heavy casualties, overwhelming their medical capacity and requiring healers to work extensively with [[madra]]. Following a period of tension involving the [[Akura clan]], the kingdom faced accusations of conspiring to assassinate members of the [[Akura head family]]. This led to a period of instability where the kingdom's status was scrutinized by [[Akura Charity]]. Ultimately, the royal line faced a crisis of succession; after the loss of other heirs, [[Seishen Daji]] was designated as the surviving heir to be returned to his people under Akura clan{{!}}Akura supervision.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Located beyond the southern jungles, the Seishen Kingdom is an elite-class society and one of the two weakest vassal states under [[Akura clan]] protection. The kingdom, which includes Prince Seishen Kiro{{!}}Prince Kiro and an [[Underlady]], has been engaged in conflict with the [[Blackflame Empire]] by pushing against its lands. During this period of warfare, the kingdom launched a feared broad attack and pushed toward the edge of the [[portal]]. Operating from a castle in [[Night Wheel Valley]], the kingdom has benefited from [[Charity]]'s garden and minted several Underlord{{!}}Underlords. To secure its interests, the Seishen Kingdom erected defenses on the other side of the [[portal]] and likely possesses ward keys for the [[boundary field]]. While the kingdom follows the [[Blackflame Empire]]'s ship, [[Mercy]] has accused [[Akura Charity]] of providing them with warnings.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|The Seishen Kingdom is the home of Seishen Daji{{!}}Prince Daji and features various hastily built constructions throughout its territory. Its flags fly over [[fortress]] walls, where rooms are prepared for [[Lindon]], who previously kept samples of the kingdom's armor in his [[soulspace]]. The realm utilizes [[Golds]] to scout via cloudships, including a notably tiny vessel, and employs [[Soulsmiths]] to design their [[constructs]]. During combat, the kingdom's Underlord{{!}}Underlords fight alongside Akura Pride{{!}}Pride and [[Mercy]], though one such [[Underlord]] was seen lying in pieces on the floor.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Seishen Kingdom is a sovereign nation that faces an uncertain future due to the actions of Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji. As the son of the kingdom, Seishen Daji{{!}}Daji's conduct has placed the entire realm in a position of great danger. Because there are no further heirs remaining, the kingdom is set to become a vassal country of the [[Akura clan]].}}
